propositions: Unchanged related-ticket pins matching a supported historical fingerprint generation (post-330c/pre-2be7) are incorrectly rejected as stale-pin-drift when derive_health compares only against the latest fingerprint.

The attestation layer's derive_plan_material_pin_health wrapper supplies only current_material_fingerprint without the legacy compatibility check (_legacy_material_ok) already applied to own-ticket validity, creating an asymmetry.

A related pin should be classified current only if it exactly matches either the latest fingerprint or a supported historical full-fingerprint recomputation of the unchanged current material; arbitrary unmatched hashes remain stale.

The fix adds a narrowly scoped optional compatibility predicate to derive_health that recomputes current related material under supported historical generations and accepts the pin if any generation matches byte-for-byte.
